repo: a document folder for a B2B scheduling SaaS that must let customers export their account data: the support ticket export about data requests (CSV), the data model overview, the privacy notice, a legal team email, the admin roles page, an enterprise customer's security questionnaire, infra limits page. About 25 files.
idea: Requirements for a self-service data export, inspired by the data portability right in public EU law (idea only). Hidden facts could cover: who may request it, formats, what is excluded, delivery deadline, download link expiry, size limits, audit logging, which plans get it.

source.licence: EU legal text, reuse authorised with source acknowledged (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU)
